english.title: Make a false or misleading statement in purported compliance with an Unexplained Wealth Order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance with a requirement imposed by an unexplained wealth order made on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..), by **(..SPECIFY COURT..),

(A)_[made a statement that was known to be]_
(B)_[recklessly made a statement that was]_

false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 362E(1) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in purported compliance with a requirement imposed by an unexplained wealth order
knowingly makes / recklessly makes a false or misleading statement

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 362E(2) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
